description: Extract text from an image (PNG, JPEG, etc.) using Tesseract OCR. Supports local file path or base64 data.

filePath.description: Local filesystem path to the image file.

language.description: Language code for OCR (e.g., 'eng' for English, 'spa' for Spanish, 'fra' for French). Defaults to 'eng'.

name: image_ocr
